dissent: none; on 29 July 2026 three members (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) dissented in favour of a 25bp hike
summary: FOMC raised the target range for the federal funds rate by 25bp to 3.75-4.00% (from 3.50-3.75%) on a unanimous 12-0 vote, after a 9-3 hold on 29 July. bank_rate and previous_bank_rate show the top of the range. The statement drops July's references to the Middle East conflict and energy supply shocks, now citing 'geopolitical developments', resilient domestic spending, strong productivity and robust capital investment, and says the action supports 'a timelier return' to the 2 percent goal.
why_it_matters: Three July hawkish dissents became a unanimous hike, so the committee moved to the hawks rather than splitting. The new 'timelier return' language frames the hike as acting on inflation, setting the baseline into the 27-28 October meeting.
